name: compare-pages
description: Add, refresh or audit a treg.to/compare page ("treg vs X"). Use when asked to compare treg with another product, add a competitor page, update a comparison's prices or facts, write or fix its FAQ, check how the comparison pages rank or show up in AI answers, or make their share images. Walks research with the treg CLI (the competitor's own pages, keyword demand, Google results, AI answers), the honesty rules, the record in compare_pages.py, SEO checks, the share image, and the tests. Keyword numbers and monitoring results never go in this public repo.
